shortDescription: SINGAPORE and NEW YORK, Oct. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GOWell Energy Technology (“GOWell” or the “Company”), a global one-stop-shop for innovative well logging solutions in the energy sector, will host a First Half 2026 Financial Results & Corporate Update Webinar on Wednesday, October 21, 2026…

children: (“GOWell” or the “Company”), a global one-stop-shop for innovative well logging solutions in the energy sector, will host a First Half 2026 Financial Results & Corporate Update Webinar on Wednesday, October 21, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. The webinar will include a formal presentation and Q&A session with management, including GOWell’s CEO Guillaume Borrel, CFO Mike Reed and VP of Corporate Development David MacNeill.
To register for this webinar, please use the registration link found
. Additionally, for those unable to listen to the live webcast, a recording will be available following the live event on GOWell’s website at www.gowell.energy.
This webinar will include commentary from the GOWell management team, with discussions focused on financial results for the first half of 2026, operational strategy and outlook.

This webinar follows the completion of GOWell’s business combination with Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V, a special purpose acquisition company, on September 25, 2026, and the commencement of trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker “GOW” on September 28, 2026.

GOWell Energy Technology is an international company that provides a wide range of innovative well logging technologies and distributed sensing solutions for energy companies globally. The Company maintains a multi-disciplinary research and development team with a robust patent portfolio of technology aimed to solve complex industry challenges. GOWell’s solutions can be applied to a wide range of wells from traditional energy to energy transition. The Company has a global, diverse customer base with long-term relationships with the key major oil service companies and operators in the energy sector. Headquartered in Singapore, GOWell has a global manufacturing and procurement network, with regional hubs in the United States and UAE in addition to regional operations that cover more than 50 countries.
For more information about GOWell Energy Technology, visit https://www.gowell.energy/.
